definitions.full: H5386. neshi [ נְשִׁי ] noun [masculine] debt ; — only suffix 2 feminine singular נשׁיכי Kt, נַשְׁיֵךְ Qr 2Kin 4:7 (so Baer; van d. H. Ginsb נִשְׁיֵךְ ) pay ( שַׁלְּמִי ) thy debt .
